en.title: Public Bin Allocation Decision Support
en.summary: From public facility maps to explainable, governed policy scenarios.
en.intendedUsers: Municipal service planners, analysts, and field-review teams evaluating possible sites.
implementedCapabilities: Policy category weights and sensitivity analysis
Explainable field-review candidates and JSON/CSV evidence exports

sections.title: Policy Problem
paragraphs: A facility map shows what is recorded, but does not explain where limited resources could address potential service gaps. This POC compares explicit allocation assumptions before field review.

Facility availability, public activity reference points, potential service gaps, site feasibility, and actual policy effectiveness are different questions. A reference point within a radius indicates modelled access; it does not establish demand, waste generation, installation feasibility, or litter reduction.
bullets: Intended users: municipal service planners, analysts, and field-review teams.

sections.title: Evolution Timeline
paragraphs: Three merged milestones build a completed decision-support proof of concept. This is a portfolio engineering result, with no further production-operations acceptance phase required for presentation.

links.label: v1.0 — Spatial Decision MVP: coverage, greedy allocation, budget/radius scenarios, field-review candidates and JSON/CSV reports · PR #11
v1.1 — Data Governance & Source Reconciliation: provenance, quality, monitoring, reviewed publication and bus-source comparison · PR #14
v1.2 — Policy-Aligned Weighted Decision Support: versioned weights, category balancing, sensitivity and candidate explanations · PR #15

sections.title: System Architecture
paragraphs: The application uses Node.js data preparation and versioned static files consumed by a React/Leaflet dashboard. This architecture does not require a running backend service or database.

sections.title: Data Governance
paragraphs: Source identifiers, retrieval/conversion timestamps, SHA256 hashes and source versions make snapshots traceable. Validation handles schema changes, missing or invalid coordinates, coordinate conversion, and duplicate locations before analysis.

The historical JSON contains 1,197 records, with an unknown resource date and a 2026-06-11 conversion date. The current CSV contains 681 rows with a 2026-09-30 resource date; excluding one invalid longitude and one duplicate coordinate leaves 679 accepted unique current locations. These are different record/location definitions, not evidence that bins were removed.

Freshness warnings and reconciliation notes remain visible. Scheduled monitoring produces review evidence; publication of a changed decision dataset requires review. The accepted base snapshot is v1-14c24bcdbade; the separate v1.2 research snapshot priority-v1-113edf6ed5e09ada remains review_required.

sections.title: Decision Methodology
paragraphs: Mode A, greedy-equal-reference-coverage-v1, maximizes newly covered eligible reference entities, treating each entity equally. Mode B, policy-balanced-coverage-v1, greedily maximizes weighted category coverage gains. The original mode remains available separately.

Versioned defaults are analytical assumptions, not official policy coefficients. Adjustable weights and sensitivity analysis expose how those assumptions change candidate ordering. Unavailable categories stay visible and contribute no fabricated points.

sections.title: Scenario Comparison
paragraphs: This is a recorded source scenario, not a live calculation. It compares equal-category weights with the policy-priority defaults inside Mode B; it does not compare Mode A against Mode B.

Conditions: citywide analysis, 300-metre radius, 10 assumed additions, 0 m minimum distance from existing bins, transport anchors, and no cost or budget constraint. The eligible snapshot contains 3,557 reference entities and 3,468 candidates.

Both configurations newly cover 125 references, yet bus-1210 moves from rank 7 to rank 3. Under defaults, increments are 13/42 vendor references, 12/47 markets, 6/73 MRT references, and 94/3,395 bus references. In the recorded 11-scenario sensitivity set (including available-category weights individually ±25%), bus-1210 ranks 3–7 and is selected in all 11. This demonstrates sensitivity to these priorities, not general robustness or better policy outcomes. Scores under different weight configurations are not directly comparable effectiveness measures.

sections.title: Engineering Challenges
paragraphs: The engineering work makes heterogeneous public records inspectable and algorithm outputs reproducible.
bullets: Convert coordinate reference systems and validate GIS bounds before map use.
Reconcile heterogeneous source formats and schema drift rather than silently replacing older records.
Retain versioned snapshots and deterministic tie-breaking for reproducible candidate rankings.
Keep allocation functions testable, and validate scenario exports and sensitivity calculations.
Separate safe source monitoring from review-controlled publication.
Use static snapshots and lazy-loaded analytical modules to manage dashboard loading costs.

sections.title: Evidence & Validation
paragraphs: Evidence links below point to the reviewed source commit. The merged PRs document implementation history; source tests and audits support engineering review. This portfolio does not claim operational certification or independently rerun source-repository test counts.

sections.title: Limitations
paragraphs: Independent personal POC; no official government endorsement, partnership, or commissioned deployment. Rankings support discussion and field review, never automatic placement approval.
bullets: The original bus reference baseline is older; newer StopLocation data were compared and not automatically adopted.
Tourism source acquisition returned HTTP 403; tourism points are unavailable for scoring.
Commercial-district records lack sufficiently verified spatial geometry; they provide context, not scoring points.
The research dataset remains review_required; category weights are assumptions rather than official coefficients.
Reference coverage does not measure waste generation, litter reduction, accessibility on actual walking routes, or policy effectiveness.
Candidate coordinates require field checks for land use, access, safety, maintenance and installation feasibility.
The v1.3 government operations workflow is deferred indefinitely.

sections.title: What This Demonstrates
paragraphs: A reusable path from requirements analysis to data engineering, system integration and GIS engineering: state the decision question, preserve provenance, make assumptions explicit, and export reproducible evidence.
Data governance, risk management, decision explainability and reproducible testing are part of the implementation. The result is a completed decision-support POC presented in a personal portfolio.

en.architectureNote: Source monitoring → review evidence → reviewed publication. Monitoring alone never publishes a replacement decision snapshot.

methodology.explanation: For each available category, divide the candidate’s additional covered references by that category’s fixed eligible total (including already covered references), then multiply by its weight and sum. This prevents thousands of bus stops from dominating solely through volume. Categories with Nₖ = 0 are omitted without redistributing their weight; each selection updates the remaining uncovered references.

zh.title: 臺北市清潔箱配置決策支援
zh.summary: 從公共設施地圖，走向具資料治理與可解釋性的政策情境分析。
zh.maturityLabel: 已完成的決策支援 POC
zh.intendedUsers: 評估候選位置的市政服務規劃者、分析人員與現勘團隊。
implementedCapabilities: 政策類別權重與敏感度分析
可解釋現勘候選點及 JSON／CSV 證據匯出

sections.title: 政策問題
paragraphs: 設施地圖可以呈現已登錄的位置，卻無法回答有限資源應優先評估哪裡。本 POC 以明確的配置假設比較潛在服務缺口，供後續討論與現勘。
設施供給、公共活動參考點、潛在服務缺口、設址可行性與實際政策成效是不同問題。半徑內的參考點覆蓋不等於需求、垃圾產生量、設置可行性或減少垃圾的成效。
bullets: 預期使用者：市政服務規劃者、分析人員與現勘團隊。

sections.title: 演進里程碑
paragraphs: 三個已合併版本形成完整的決策支援概念驗證。作為個人工程作品集展示，不需另設正式營運驗收階段。

links.label: v1.0 — 空間決策 MVP：覆蓋分析、貪婪配置、預算／半徑情境、現勘候選點及 JSON／CSV 報告 · PR #11
v1.1 — 資料治理與來源對帳：來源、品質、監測、審閱後發布及公車來源比較 · PR #14
v1.2 — 政策導向加權決策：版本化權重、類別平衡、敏感度及候選點解釋 · PR #15

sections.title: 系統架構
paragraphs: Node.js 進行資料前處理，以版本化靜態檔案供 React／Leaflet 介面使用；此流程不宣稱存在常駐後端服務或資料庫。

sections.title: 資料治理
paragraphs: 保留來源識別、擷取／轉換時間、SHA256 與來源版本，讓快照可追溯。分析前處理欄位變更、缺漏或無效座標、座標轉換及重複位置。
歷史 JSON 有 1,197 筆紀錄，資源日期未知，轉換日期為 2026-06-11。現行 CSV 有 681 列，資源日期為 2026-09-30；排除 1 筆無效經度及 1 筆重複座標後，接受 679 個有效且唯一的現行位置。兩者紀錄與位置定義不同，差額不能解讀為清潔箱遭移除。
介面保留資料新鮮度警告與對帳說明。排程監測產出待審證據，決策資料變更須經審閱才發布；基準快照為 v1-14c24bcdbade；獨立 v1.2 研究快照 priority-v1-113edf6ed5e09ada 仍標示 review_required。

links.label: 清潔箱對帳與數量定義

sections.title: 決策方法
paragraphs: 模式 A：greedy-equal-reference-coverage-v1，將每個合格參考實體視為等價，貪婪選取新增覆蓋最多的位置。模式 B：policy-balanced-coverage-v1，以類別加權覆蓋增益選點；原始模式仍獨立保留。
版本化預設權重是分析假設，並非官方政策係數。可調權重與敏感度分析揭露假設如何影響排序；缺少資料的類別仍明確顯示，不虛構點位。

sections.title: 情境比較
paragraphs: 以下為來源庫已記錄的情境，並非即時計算。比較的是模式 B 內等類別權重與政策優先預設權重，不是模式 A 與模式 B 的比較。
條件：全市、300 公尺半徑、假設新增 10 座、與既有清潔箱最小距離 0 公尺、交通錨點，未設定成本或預算限制。合格快照包含 3,557 個參考實體、3,468 個候選點。

兩種設定均新增覆蓋 125 個參考實體，但 bus-1210 由第 7 名變成第 3 名。預設權重下新增覆蓋：攤販 13／42、市場 12／47、捷運 6／73、公車 94／3,395。已記錄的 11 組敏感度情境（含各可用類別權重各自 ±25%）中，bus-1210 排名為第 3–7 名，11 組均入選；此為這些假設下的排序觀察，不能推論一般穩健性或政策成效較佳；不同權重下的分數不能直接比較政策有效性。

links.label: 可重現的情境分析 JSON

sections.title: 工程挑戰
paragraphs: 透過可檢查的資料處理與確定性演算法，讓公開紀錄能被追溯與重現。
bullets: 轉換座標參考系統，並檢查 GIS 範圍。
對帳異質來源格式與欄位漂移，避免默默取代舊資料。
保存版本快照，以確定性的同分排序重現候選點。
保持配置函式可測試，驗證情境匯出與敏感度計算。
將安全來源監測與審閱後發布分開。
以靜態快照與分析模組延遲載入管理載入成本。

sections.title: 工程證據與驗證
paragraphs: 下列證據固定至已審閱的來源 commit。合併 PR 說明實作歷程，來源測試與稽核支援工程複核。本作品集不宣稱正式營運認證，也不將來源記錄的測試結果稱為本次獨立重跑。

sections.title: 限制與負責任使用
paragraphs: 此為獨立個人 POC，並非政府官方背書、合作或委託系統。排序供討論與現勘，不可自動核准設置。
bullets: 原始公車參考基準較舊；新版 StopLocation 僅進行比較，未自動採用。
觀光資料擷取收到 HTTP 403，無可用觀光計分點。
商圈資料缺乏充分驗證的空間幾何，只提供脈絡，不納入計分。
研究資料仍為 review_required；權重是分析假設，不是官方係數。
參考點覆蓋不衡量垃圾產生、垃圾減量、實際步行可達性或政策成效。
候選座標仍需確認用地、通行、安全、維護及設置可行性。
v1.3 政府營運工作流程無限期延後。

sections.title: 本案例展現的能力
paragraphs: 從需求分析、資料工程、系統整合到 GIS 工程，建立可重用流程：界定決策問題、保存來源、揭露假設、匯出可重現證據。
資料治理、風險管理、決策可解釋性與可重現測試均屬於實作內容；成果定位為個人作品集中的已完成決策支援 POC。

architecture: 情境比較／簡報證據匯出
zh.architectureNote: 來源監測 → 待審證據 → 審閱後發布。監測本身不會發布替代決策快照。

methodology.explanation: 對每個可用類別，將候選點新增覆蓋數除以該類別固定合格總數（含原已覆蓋參考點），乘上權重後加總，避免數千個公車站只因資料量而主導結果。Nₖ = 0 的類別省略，權重不重新分配；每次選點後更新尚未覆蓋的參考點。
